Erick Strickland is a former professional basketball player.
Erick Strickland played in the NBA.
Erick Strickland was born in Opelika, Alabama.
Erick Strickland attended Bellevue West High School in Bellevue, Nebraska.
Erick Strickland played his college basketball career at the University of Nebraska.
Erick Strickland was the 2nd all time scorer for Class A Nebraska basketball.
Erick Strickland was undrafted in the 1996 NBA draft.
Erick Strickland caught on as a free agent with the Dallas Mavericks.
Erick Strickland spent four seasons with the Dallas Mavericks.
Erick Strickland averaged 12.8 points per game during his time with the Dallas Mavericks in 1999-2000.
Erick Strickland played for the New York Knicks.
Erick Strickland played for the Vancouver Grizzlies.
Erick Strickland played for the Boston Celtics.
Erick Strickland played for the Indiana Pacers.
Erick Strickland played for the Milwaukee Bucks.
Erick Strickland averaged 7.5 points per game during his NBA career.
Erick Strickland played two seasons of minor league baseball.
Erick Strickland played in the Gulf Coast League with the Gulf Coast Marlins in 1992.
Erick Strickland played in the New York–Penn League with the Elmira Pioneers in 1993.
Erick Strickland was a full two years younger than the average batter in his league in 1993.
Erick Strickland led the Elmira Pioneers in triples.
Erick Strickland finished second in stolen bases for the Elmira Pioneers.
Erick Strickland finished second in bases on balls for the Elmira Pioneers.
